notes: New test book: هندسه جامع (v1.11.49). 11 chapters, 104 exams (آزمون ۱ تا ۱۰۴) from the user's book TOC (~/workspace/user/files/upload.pdf); each chapter's sections are that chapter's exams with their topic names, per the user's instruction. Chapter 12 (پاسخنامه کلیدی) is NOT included — not testable content. Every section total is null and the book has no known total — no counts are invented; the user enters them later via the per-chapter bulk entry. The book is now the 5th test book (geometry previously had none). Wiring: bookOfSubject and bookIdForSubject now map هندسه -> geom (same as گسسته -> disc), so exam-budget linking, the coverage map and weak-chapter suggestions can use it; bookForSubject/subjectForBook are untouched (disc is not wired there either). New seed books now reach an EXISTING v2 testbook.json: loadAll appends whole seed books missing by id (never touches existing books or the user's counts) — previously the seed was only consulted for the v1 migration, so an existing v2 file would never have seen the new book. No other change.
